verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents PlayCanvas's 3D physics (rigidbody/collision components via ammo.js/Bullet), 3D rendering (WebGPU/WebGL, Gaussian Splatting), and general engine/editor features, but contains no mention of sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics, or any first-class 2D workflow. As a general-purpose game engine, 2D support is a fair axis to ask about, but nothing in the pack confirms it exists or is treated as anything other than a 3D-focused engine.
